title: Orbit ranks dimensions and closure order for complex type-AIII Grassmannian-times-double-flag varieties
author: Fresse, Lucas; Nishiyama, Kyo
work: On generalized Steinberg theory for type AIII
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs unique partial-permutation graph normal forms, computes stabilizer dimensions from graph statistics, and realizes every allowed rank-order cover through explicit one-parameter orbit degenerations. A combinatorial interpolation between rank arrays proves the reverse closure inclusion, not just semicontinuity of ranks.
